fb_text:
Your first hire's first week. Your phone never stops.

Where's the gate code? What did we flag last visit? Does the back lot get service too? Every question routes to you — while you're standing on a job yourself.

Then the shift: he voice-notes between stops, same as he always talked. The log keeps every answer. Next time the question comes up, it answers — not you.

Dinner gets quiet again.

I built FieldNotes for my own business — a commercial plant service running 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. The first-hire week is exactly why it exists.

Try it free for 30 days, no credit card — start with the 60-second demo:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
